# pve_version (Data Source)

Returns the Proxmox VE version of the configured API endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_version" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `release` (String) PVE major.minor release, e.g. `9.2`.
- `repoid` (String) PVE repository commit id.
- `version` (String) PVE version, e.g. `9.2.2`.
